resources.string: Set Agora as your default digital assistant. When enabled, the assist gesture or power-button handoff brings Agora forward and lets it read the current screen to help. All access is granted by you; Agora never injects input into other apps.
Tap to make Agora your device assistant
The assistant role is not available on this device
A draggable box to chat with Agora from any app. Long-press it (or tap ✕) to dismiss.
Needs permission to draw over other apps
Type or tap the mic to ask Agora. Responses appear here.
Download the offline speech model (~52 MB) to dictate by voice. Runs fully on-device; no audio leaves the phone.
Speech model installed. Tap to remove.
Tap to grant microphone access and download the model
Download the offline speech model in Settings to dictate.
